name: Cinematic
description: Modern scoring-stage sound: full strings and brass over a wide percussion section, with harp and piano for color. Built for big dynamic swings — long quiet builds into heavy tutti. Budget: at most 9 concurrent layers, energy clamp [0.35, 0.95], the widest of any band; the ceiling is a hard constraint, the floor is a soft directive. Woodwinds keep clear of brass stab windows, and octave doubling is free — big unison-and-octave tuttis are part of the style. Every role is a track the app already has.
